offering_description.value: DoubleVerify sells software that measures digital ad quality and performance for advertisers, agencies, publishers, and advertising platforms. It delivers verification, campaign optimization, and marketing attribution through dashboards and integrations with ad buying and publishing platforms.

primary_products.value: ad fraud detection software; brand safety and suitability tools; ad viewability and attention measurement tools; campaign optimization software; marketing attribution and publisher analytics software

customer_segment.value: B2B: Advertisers, media agencies, ad buying platforms, social media platforms, and digital publishers

end_markets.value: digital advertising; digital publishing; social media; connected television and streaming media

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Ad impressions screened, verified, or measured; subscription: Recurring access to publisher analytics and marketing measurement software

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Analyzes ad placement, impression, and campaign data for advertisers, agencies, publishers, and ad platforms

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: Ad verification, attention measurement, campaign optimization, marketing attribution, and publisher analytics

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Enterprise sales to advertisers, agencies, publishers, and ad platforms; partners / resellers: Integrations with demand-side platforms and other ad buying tools that offer verification and measurement to media buyers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Ad measurement and data processing are subject to privacy rules including the EU GDPR and California CCPA.

notes: The mix of fixed-fee and usage-based contracts varies by product.
